description.value: Chaiiwala of London is a British-Indian street food cafe chain originating in the UK, known for its signature Karak Chaii (a spiced South Asian milk tea) and Wala Wraps — fillings tucked into fluffy naan. With over 130 locations across five countries and more than 100 million cups sold, the brand blends chai-house culture with fast-casual street food. A touring cyclist stopping in would find a warm, quick-service cafe with Indian-inspired snacks and hot and cold drinks.
